about.title: Ka ga Mframapa AI
about.overview.desc: Mframapa AI e akanya PM2.5 letsatsi le letsatsi mo dinageng tse 54 tsa Afrika.
about.overview.problem_desc: Ditoropo di le dintsi tsa Afrika ga di na le didirisiwa tsa go tlhatlhoba mowa. Re tlatsa sekgeo seo.
about.how.intro: Go dirisa data ya satellite le go ithuta ga motšhine.
about.how.step1.title: Di-Satellite jaaka Disensors
about.how.step1.desc: Go dirisa data ya ESA Sentinel-5P le NASA MERRA-2.
about.how.step2.title: Go Lokisa ga Lefatshe
about.how.step2.desc: Modele e rutegile mo mafelong a 398 a go tlhatlhoba mo dinageng tse 29.
about.how.step3.title: Inference ya Kontinente
about.how.step3.desc: Modele ya XGBoost e bontsha PM2.5 go lefelo lepe le lepe la Afrika.
about.limit.intro: Dikgoreletsi tse di botlhokwa tse o tshwanetseng go di itse.
about.limit.cloud_desc: Di-satellite ga di kgone go bona ka maru a magolo.
about.limit.gap_desc: Go feta ga satellite letsatsi le letsatsi go ka fosisiwa ke dikgeo tse khutshwane tsa pošo.
about.limit.legal_desc: Ditekanyetso ga se ditekanyetso tse di amogetsweng.
about.who.citizens_desc: Tlhatlhoba boleng jwa mowa pele ga ditiro tsa kwa ntle.
